advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure the parent-drift breadcrumb is still evaluated for a drift child with no local comments on the live-search snapshot path (do not return [] before the breadcrumb check).
evidence: The breadcrumb call is only reached at lines 752-760, after all the live-search early returns (636, 649, 668).
A child whose parent field was suppressed is precisely a leaf that may have NO local comments; on the live-search shape it is skipped.
advisory.finding: On the live-search snapshot shape (snapshot entry lacks the 'comment' field), _diff_comments returns [] at the `if not local_comments` guard before _build_parent_breadcrumb is ever called, so a drift-affected child with no local comments never receives a breadcrumb on that path — the exact under-defined-leaf case the feature targets.
scenarios: A bound drift child with zero local comments whose snapshot entry came from live search (no embedded 'comment' field) — no breadcrumb is ever emitted.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the breadcrumb append-once check against a truncated jira_bodies (e.g. skip emitting the breadcrumb when the comment set is known-truncated, or only trust the tag-absence when the full comment set was resolved).
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:491: `    if any(PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG in body for body in jira_bodies):`
src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/outbound_comments.py:625: `            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail-open to the truncated subset (bug 4292)`
jira_bodies is built from jira_comments at lines 670-673, which on the truncation-refetch-failure path is the capped `embedded` subset.
The truncation guard comment (lines 607-614) states embedded comments are capped at ~20 while total is larger; a breadcrumb landed past position 20 is not in the subset.
advisory.finding: The append-once guard `any(PARENT_BREADCRUMB_TAG in body for body in jira_bodies)` keys against jira_bodies, which may be a TRUNCATED subset: when the bulk /search/jql enrichment caps embedded comments and the live re-fetch fails, the code fails open to the truncated subset (line 625). A previously-landed breadcrumb beyond the cap is then absent from jira_bodies, the guard misses it, and a duplicate breadcrumb is emitted — breaking first-writer-wins.
scenarios: An issue with >~20 comments whose breadcrumb sits past the enrichment cap, when the per-ticket re-fetch fails (transport error): the dedup set lacks the breadcrumb and a second one is posted.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the AC-cited test name with the shipped test name (rename the test or update the ticket AC) so AC-to-test traceability holds.
evidence: The renamed test still exercises the append-once/first-writer-wins behaviour, so the contract is covered under a different name.
advisory.finding: Ticket AC #2 claims coverage by `test_parent_breadcrumb.py::test_breadcrumb_idempotent_and_supersede`, but the shipped test is named `test_breadcrumb_idempotent_across_ancestor_change` and no supersede behaviour is tested (the ticket explicitly accepts no supersede). The AC's cited test name does not exist.
scenarios: An auditor tracing the ticket AC to a test by the cited name finds no such test.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a negative test asserting NO breadcrumb when the direct parent's type is 'epic' (and one for a missing parent type) to pin the drift gate at outbound_comments.py:488-489.
evidence: Source gate: outbound_comments.py:488-490 `parent_type = local_ticket_types.get(parent_id)` / `if parent_type is None or str(parent_type).lower() == "epic": return []`
Docstring contract: outbound_comments.py:472-473 `A missing/epic parent type means the parent field is NOT suppressed → no breadcrumb`
All positive/emit tests pass `local_ticket_types={"P1": "task"}` (lines 89, 142, 161, 186, 206); no test feeds an `"epic"` parent type or omits the type asserting `_breadcrumbs(out) == []`.

ABSENCE: this drift gate is the feature's central discrimination (only non-epic suppressed parents drift), yet neither disjunct's suppression path is pinned — an inverted gate that always emitted (or emitted for epic parents) would not fail any test.
blocking.finding: No test exercises the epic-parent (or missing-parent-type) branch of the drift gate: a child whose direct parent IS an epic (or whose parent type is absent) must get NO breadcrumb, but every positive test uses ticket_type 'task' and no test asserts suppression for an epic/missing type. Removing or inverting the gate at outbound_comments.py:489 (`parent_type is None or str(parent_type).lower() == "epic"`) would leave the whole suite green.
scenarios: A refactor loosens the drift gate so an epic parent also triggers a breadcrumb — the suite stays green while producing spurious/duplicate breadcrumbs for correctly-represented epic parents.
local_ticket_types lookup returns None (parent not in the map) and the code emits anyway after a future edit — no test catches it.
blocking.suggested_fix: Add `test_no_breadcrumb_when_parent_is_epic` (same fixture as test_breadcrumb_emitted but `local_ticket_types={"P1": "epic"}`) asserting `_breadcrumbs(out) == []`, and a `test_no_breadcrumb_when_parent_type_missing` with `local_ticket_types={}`.
